_comment: The measured Synthea comparison, with the provenance needed to detect that it has
gone stale. This file exists because the claim it replaced -- Synthea scoring 0% on
blood-pressure control -- was false for an unknown length of time, and survived
because it was cited rather than run. Replacing a stale citation with a measurement
that nothing re-runs would repeat the same failure one level up.
Regenerate with the commands in `carebundle/benchmark/synthea.py`, then
.github/workflows/synthea-drift.yml re-runs it monthly and fails if the figures move
or if Synthea has published a new build.

_reproducibility: A fixed seed does NOT make this reproducible across machines. The same build and
seed produced 1462 bundles here and 1449 in CI: `-p` counts living patients and
generation is concurrent, so the number of deceased records exported varies with
thread interleaving. Observed spread between those runs was 0.002 on the CBP rate
and 0.016 on the mean dependence deviation. The tolerances in drift.py are sized
against that, not against an assumption of determinism.

_comment: Synthea's figure is the median of three generation runs of the same build and
seed, which do not produce identical populations; the runs are listed so a
single lucky draw cannot become the published number.
Mean absolute deviation from the committed NHANES extraction across 7 analyte
pairs x 2 sexes, ages 45-65. Both sides are medians with their observed spread,
because reporting one seeded draw for this package against a noisy average for
Synthea would flatter this package. Synthea varies run to run even at a fixed
seed; this package is deterministic per seed and varies across seeds instead.

diabetic_amputation._comment: Hodges et al., JAMIA Open 2023, report 100% of Synthea type-2 diabetics carrying an amputation. It does not reproduce.
